steps: Go to https://usbank.com/splash/checking/2026-all-market-checking-offer.html and click an Apply button to start a Bank Smartly Checking application
Complete the application online by November 10, 2026 (the promo auto-applies through this page; in branch/by phone ask the banker to activate the offer at opening)
Fund the new account with at least $25 within 60 days of account opening (also the $25 minimum opening deposit)
Enroll in the U.S. Bank Mobile App or online banking within 90 days of account opening
Set up payroll/government-benefits direct deposits and receive 2 or more totaling $5,000-$7,999.99 within 90 days of account opening (exclude Venmo/P2P transfers — they don't count)
Keep the account open with a positive balance; the $350 bonus posts as an 'adjusted interest' credit within 30 days after all requirements are complete
